// Build this file inside a disposable checkout of the exact pinned Hatchet source.
// It exercises the public Go SDK without adding Hatchet dependencies to Multica.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"log"
	"os"
	"time"
	"github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet/pkg/cmdutils"
	hatchet "github.com/hatchet-dev/hatchet/sdks/go"
)

type input struct {
	RunID string `json:"multica_run_id"`
	Delay int `json:"delay"`
	Payload map[string]any `json:"payload"`
}

func main() {
	revision := os.Getenv("PROBE_REVISION")
	if revision != "r1" && revision != "r2" { log.Fatal("expected PROBE_REVISION=r1 or r2") }
	client, err := hatchet.NewClient()
	if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
	task := client.NewStandaloneDurableTask("mc-contract-"+revision,
		func(ctx hatchet.DurableContext, in input) (map[string]any,error) {
			_,err:=ctx.Memo("external-effect",func()(any,error){
				f,err:=os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("PROBE_EFFECTS"),os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND,0600)
				if err!=nil{return nil,err};defer f.Close()
				if _,err:=f.WriteString(in.RunID+" "+revision+"\n");err!=nil{return nil,err}
				return "recorded",nil
			})
			if err!=nil{return nil,err}
			ctx.Log("probe "+revision)
			if _,err:=ctx.SleepFor(time.Duration(in.Delay)*time.Second);err!=nil{return nil,err}
			completion:=map[string]any{"runId":in.RunID,"revision":revision,"invocation":ctx.InvocationCount(),"resumedAt":time.Now().UTC()}
			f,err:=os.OpenFile(os.Getenv("PROBE_COMPLETIONS"),os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND,0600)
			if err!=nil{return nil,err}
			err=json.NewEncoder(f).Encode(completion)
			closeErr:=f.Close()
			if err!=nil{return nil,err};if closeErr!=nil{return nil,closeErr}
			return map[string]any{"revision":revision,"multica_run_id":in.RunID,"payload":in.Payload},nil
		},
		hatchet.WithWorkflowIdempotency(hatchet.IdempotencyConfig{Expression:"input.multica_run_id",TTL:time.Hour}),
		hatchet.WithExecutionTimeout(5*time.Minute),
	)
	worker,err:=client.NewWorker("mc-probe-"+revision,hatchet.WithWorkflows(task),hatchet.WithDurableSlots(5))
	if err!=nil{log.Fatal(err)}
	ctx,cancel:=cmdutils.NewInterruptContext();defer cancel()
	if err:=worker.StartBlocking(ctx);err!=nil{log.Fatal(err)}
}
